contracts.permitted_uses: Titles, links, declared licences, listing positions, dates and counts from the source discovery collector's private exports of public listings.
contracts.never_used: Abstracts, descriptions and any text the listings carry beyond names; the exports omit them already.
contracts.attribution: Public listings read by Baltor's source discovery collector: Hugging Face daily papers and blog, GitHub search, the official Model Context Protocol registry, npm and the skills.sh directory.
contracts.failure_policy: A read that fails is recorded as could not check, never as no change; the previous brief is not renewed. A partial collector run is recorded as partially checked.

contracts.permitted_uses: Model names, makers, licences, parameter counts, context sizes, file sizes, download counts and capability flags that the packaged directory took from Hugging Face or models.dev.
contracts.never_used: Model card prose, and every value the directory took from OpenRouter or published by Artificial Analysis. Decision 7 of docs/research/SHARED-RESEARCH-SERVICE-LANDSCAPE-2026-09-27.md: stored facts come from openly licensed sources.
contracts.attribution: Baltor model directory (baltor.ai/models), for the values it took from the Hugging Face Hub and models.dev.
contracts.failure_policy: A read that fails is recorded as could not check, never as no change; the previous brief is not renewed.

contracts.permitted_uses: Endpoint names, interface styles, tool and structured output support and the addresses of documentation, pricing, rate limit and data policy pages.
contracts.never_used: Policy text beyond the page addresses, and every value the directory took from OpenRouter. Decision 7 of docs/research/SHARED-RESEARCH-SERVICE-LANDSCAPE-2026-09-27.md: stored facts come from openly licensed sources.
contracts.attribution: Baltor endpoint directory (baltor.ai/endpoints), for the values it took from provider documentation.
contracts.failure_policy: A read that fails is recorded as could not check, never as no change; the previous brief is not renewed.

contracts.permitted_uses: Server names, publishers, categories, offering kinds, transports, authentication kinds, licences, repository addresses and update days.
contracts.never_used: Server descriptions; they are read only to prove a brief does not repeat them.
contracts.attribution: Baltor directory of protocol servers and agent interfaces (baltor.ai/directory), built from the official Model Context Protocol registry, GitHub's directory and the Docker catalog.
contracts.failure_policy: A read that fails is recorded as could not check, never as no change; the previous brief is not renewed.

contracts.permitted_uses: Names and official links a person chose for a question.
contracts.never_used: Any number, price or claim about a service.
contracts.attribution: The Baltor knowledge radar question registry.
contracts.failure_policy: A seed whose link check fails keeps no verification date and is shown as not verified.

contracts.permitted_uses: The HTTP status of each seed link, to prove the link resolves on the day of the run.
contracts.never_used: Page content; the body is measured for size and digest and discarded.
contracts.failure_policy: A failed or refused link check leaves the seed unverified; it is never counted as resolved.

contracts.permitted_uses: Repository names, addresses, star and fork counts, languages, topics, detected licences, archive flags and creation and push times.
contracts.never_used: Repository descriptions and README text; descriptions are kept in memory only as a guard against copying.
contracts.attribution: GitHub repository search, read through the operator's gh login.
contracts.failure_policy: A read that fails is recorded as could not check, never as no change; the previous brief is not renewed. A 404, 410, 401 or 403 answer is recorded as source disappeared or access changed and needs a person to review the binding.

contracts.permitted_uses: Advisory identifiers, CVE identifiers, severities, ecosystems, package names, affected ranges, fixed versions and dates.
contracts.failure_policy: A read that fails is recorded as could not check, never as no change; the previous brief is not renewed.

contracts.permitted_uses: Release tags, previous tags, publication times and release page addresses.
contracts.attribution: GitHub releases of each named repository.
contracts.failure_policy: A read that fails is recorded as could not check, never as no change; the previous brief is not renewed. A 404, 410, 401 or 403 answer is recorded as source disappeared or access changed and needs a person to review the binding.

contracts.permitted_uses: Provider names, tiers, categories, compatibility flags, official addresses and the free tier text the owner recorded, with the commit date.
contracts.never_used: Notes and any code; the directory file is parsed as a syntax tree and never run.
contracts.attribution: The owner's MIT-licensed public directory repositories on GitHub (TaylorAmarelTech).
contracts.failure_policy: A read that fails is recorded as could not check, never as no change; the previous brief is not renewed.

contracts.failure_policy: A read that fails is recorded as could not check, never as no change; the previous brief is not renewed. A 404, 410, 401 or 403 answer is recorded as source disappeared or access changed and needs a person to review the binding.

contracts.permitted_uses: Paper identifiers, titles, categories, author counts, versions and dates. arXiv metadata is CC0.
contracts.never_used: Abstracts; they are kept in memory only as a guard against copying.
contracts.attribution: arXiv query interface. Thank you to arXiv for use of its open access interoperability.
contracts.failure_policy: A read that fails is recorded as could not check, never as no change; the previous brief is not renewed.

contracts.failure_policy: A read that fails is recorded as could not check, never as no change; the previous brief is not renewed. Requests stay inside the free daily allowance; the run spends nothing.

contracts.permitted_uses: Product release cycles, release dates, end of active support and end of life dates, latest versions and long-term support flags. The data is MIT licensed.
contracts.failure_policy: A read that fails is recorded as could not check, never as no change; the previous brief is not renewed. A 404, 410, 401 or 403 answer is recorded as source disappeared or access changed and needs a person to review the binding.

contracts.permitted_uses: Document numbers, titles, types, agencies, publication, effective and comment dates.
contracts.never_used: Summaries and abstracts; they are never requested. The web rendition is not the official legal edition.

contracts.failure_policy: A read that fails is recorded as could not check, never as no change; the previous brief is not renewed.

contracts.permitted_uses: A live lookup only: identifiers and fingerprints for private change detection. Nothing from the listing is stored in a served file.
contracts.never_used: Stored in any brief, table or served file: the terms of August 31, 2026, section 7, forbid software that copies information from the service and uses that develop a competing service. Decision 7 of docs/research/SHARED-RESEARCH-SERVICE-LANDSCAPE-2026-09-27.md: stored facts come from openly licensed sources.
contracts.failure_policy: A read that fails is recorded as could not check, never as no change; the previous brief is not renewed. The listing sends no validators, so each check reads it whole.

contracts.failure_policy: A read that fails is recorded as could not check, never as no change; the previous brief is not renewed. A publisher whose listing fails is named, and the check is partial.

contracts.permitted_uses: Model and provider identifiers, capability flags (tool calling, structured output, reasoning, open weights), context and output limits, listed prices, release and update dates. The catalogue is MIT licensed.
contracts.never_used: Model descriptions, and the entries models.dev keeps for the OpenRouter provider. Decision 7 of docs/research/SHARED-RESEARCH-SERVICE-LANDSCAPE-2026-09-27.md: stored facts come from openly licensed sources.
contracts.failure_policy: A read that fails is recorded as could not check, never as no change; the previous brief is not renewed. The catalogue sends an ETag, so the hourly watch reads it again only when it changed.
